trap-bar-deadlift.criteria: Step inside loaded hexagonal frame, hip-width feet, neutral side handles, coordinated knee/hip extension and controlled return to floor. Low-handle variant.

kettlebell-sumo-deadlift.criteria: Single kettlebell centered between wide feet with toes slightly out, close double-overhand grip, hips below shoulders, push through whole foot then return to floor.

fat-grip-deadlift.criteria: Conventional floor deadlift with thick grip adapters only under the hands; standard shaft elsewhere. Double-overhand grip; no claim of product replica.

limits: Procedural demonstration with illustrative equipment proportions and eight-second timing. Stylized skinning/shorts without fabric simulation; sampled geometry is not exhaustive mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Physical-device and production verification pending.
